name: Bybit BTC/USDT displayed best quote
description: The displayed best bid and ask from the Bybit BTC/USDT ticker input, with the exact-decimal midpoint (bid plus ask divided by two) and spread_bps as (ask minus bid) divided by midpoint times 10000. input_age_ms is the admission time minus the quote's logical receipt time. Ready output requires a positive uncrossed quote received no more than 10000 milliseconds before production. Readiness guards evaluate full internal decimal precision before rounding. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Bybit inputs and is ready whenever the Bybit quote is positive, uncrossed, and inside the staleness bound, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Venue port (B1): this identity is the Bybit sibling of `btc.coinbase.spot_quote@1.0.0` and reuses that definition's formulas, windows, thresholds, warm-up, staleness bound, field set, field types and eight-place round-half-to-even rounding verbatim; only the source ids differ (`crates/btc-signals/src/spot_signals.rs`, `crates/btc-signals/src/candidate_spot_signals.rs`). The instrument is Bybit spot BTCUSDT; at decision time every price-level field is converted from the venue's USDT quote to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid, while ratio fields (basis points, imbalances, ratios, counts) are quote-currency neutral. Bybit inputs are rights-gated (`signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md`): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list `SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES` names `bybit`, which the deployment sets only after that row clears. The Bybit quote input is the `orderbook.1.BTCUSDT` stream (10 ms, snapshot plus delta, one level per side). Unlike the Coinbase ticker it is level-row shaped: the displayed best quote is the retained bid row and ask row of that one-level book, each seeded by a snapshot, and a delta that carries only one side updates only that side. A quote is available only once both sides have been seeded. quote_currency is emitted on every decision and is the constant "usd" for this venue: every price-denominated field is converted from the venue's USDT quote to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid, while ratio, basis-point, base-size and count fields are quote-currency neutral. E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD. The venue trades BTC against USDT, so at decision time every price, notional and quote-denominated cost field (bid, ask, midpoint) is converted USDT to USD with the latest USDT/USD reference rate; base-denominated fields (base sizes, counts, basis-point ratios, durations) are unchanged. The reference is kraken.spot.usdt-usd.ticker, delivered on the dedicated Kraken reference socket (a second reference, coinbase.exchange.usdt-usd.ticker, joins when it lands). quote_currency is the constant "usd". usdt_usd_rate (decimal, eight places, round-half-to-even) and usdt_usd_rate_age_ms are published on every ready decision, and the identity is non-ready with reason usdt_reference_stale when the rate is absent or older than 60000 milliseconds.
